 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Argentina host Costa Rica in an intriguing friendly in Cordoba on Tuesday, as the 2026 World Cup runners up aim to get back on track after a rare defeat.
 In their first game following Lionel Messi's retirement from the international game, Argentina lost 2-1 at home to Uruguay in a friendly on Friday. La Bombonera was left stunned as Lionel Scaloni's side conceded twice in five minutes early in the second half to go 2-0 down.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Julian Alvarez's late goal set up a wild finale, but Argentina couldn't find an equalizer as they lost a game at home for the first time since November 2023, as that defeat ironically also came against Uruguay at La Bombonera in Buenos Aires.
 Costa Rica will provide a tricky test for Argentina but they are in a bit of a rut after their shock failure to not qualify for the 2026 World Cup despite Canada, the USA and Mexico all not taking part in CONCACAF qualifying. Los Ticos have former legendary playmaker Bryan Ruiz as their head coach and they are building a new team and put up a good fight in their 2-0 defeat at Ecuador on Friday.
 How to watch Argentina vs Costa Rica live, stream link and start time 
 Kick off time : 6pm ET Tuesday (November 17)
 Venue : Estadio Mario Alberto Kempes — Cordoba, Argentina
 TV Channel / Streaming : ViX, Prime Video USA
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Argentina team news 
 Other than Messi retiring, this is pretty much the same Argentina squad which almost won back-to-back World Cups in the summer. Scaloni has signed a new contract through the end of the 2030 World Cup and Argentina have so much quality in attack with Alvarez, Enzo Fernandez and Alexis Mac Allister tasked with popping up with goals and assists when it matters most. Argentina will rotate their lineup slightly for this friendly but Scaloni will want to see a big response after the disappointing defeat against Uruguay.
 Costa Rica team news 
 The brilliant Costa Rica teams who excelled at the 2014 World Cup, plus qualified for both the 2018 and 2022 World Cups, seem like a very distant memory. The likes of Jeyland Mitchell and Josimar Alcocer are in playing in Europe at Strasbourg and Sparta Prague respectively and are two young players to keep a close eye on. The main focus for Ruiz is making Costa Rica relevant in CONCACAF again and building towards qualifying for the 2030 World Cup.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Argentina vs Costa Rica prediction 
 This feels like Argentina could take out some of their anger from the defeat to Uruguay. Costa Rica will sit deep and frustrate Argentina but they will be overwhelmed. Argentina 4-1 Costa Rica .
